intro: The Z2 Pro Vogue (Walnut) is a premium under-sink RO water purifier designed for modern kitchens. Featuring 7-stage purification, Copper Fortified Mineralizer (CFM), and Alkaline Technology, it delivers safe, mineral-rich drinking water while maintaining a sleek, clutter-free countertop. With up to 55% water recovery, it saves twice as much water as conventional RO purifiers.
features: Removes bacteria, viruses, dissolved salts, and contaminants
notes: Modern walnut finish complements contemporary kitchens.
